# Data preparation

## Script to get distribution of number of orthogroups with different numbers of genes

Just for orthogroups with all species present.

```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/
mkdir phylo_tree
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree
mkdir input_orthogroups

GENECOUNT="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.GeneCount.tsv"

awk '
BEGIN { FS="\t" }

NR > 1 {
    all_present = 1

    for (i = 2; i <= NF - 1; i++) {
        if ($i == 0) {
            all_present = 0
            break
        }
    }

    if (all_present)
        print $NF
}
' ${GENECOUNT} |
sort -n |
uniq -c
```

```{sh}
GENECOUNT="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.GeneCount.tsv"
MAX_GENES=30

OUT_PREFIX="input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max${MAX_GENES}"

echo "Input file: ${GENECOUNT}"
echo "Maximum number of genes per orthogroup: ${MAX_GENES}"
echo

# Overwrite existing output files
> "${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv"
> "${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt"

awk -v maxgenes="$MAX_GENES" \
    -v outfile="${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv" \
    -v idfile="${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt" '
BEGIN {
    FS = OFS = "\t"
}

NR == 1 {
    # OrthoFinder GeneCount table:
    # column 1 = Orthogroup
    # columns 2...(NF-1) = species
    # last column = Total

    nspecies = NF - 2

    print "Number of species detected:", nspecies > "/dev/stderr"

    print $0 >> outfile
    next
}

{
    all_present = 1

    # Check whether every species has at least one gene
    for (i = 2; i <= NF - 1; i++) {
        if ($i == 0) {
            all_present = 0
            break
        }
    }

    total_genes = $NF

    if (all_present) {
        complete++

        if (total_genes <= maxgenes) {
            retained++
            print $0 >> outfile
            print $1 >> idfile
        }
    }
}

END {
    print ""
    print "Summary:"
    print "Complete orthogroups (all species present):", complete
    print "Complete orthogroups with <=", maxgenes, "genes:", retained
}
' "$GENECOUNT"

echo
echo "Output files:"
echo "  ${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv"
echo "  ${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt"

```

# MAFFT alignment of orthogroups

```{sh}
### Metacentrum script

#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N mafft_orthogroups
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=32:mem=64gb:scratch_local=10gb
#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00
#PBS -m ae

set -euo pipefail

############################
# User-defined variables
############################

# Directory with OrthoFinder orthogroup FASTA files
INPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroup_Sequences"

# File containing selected orthogroup IDs, one per line
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Directory for MAFFT alignments
OUTPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/mafft_alignments"

# Number of parallel MAFFT jobs
NCPU=32

############################
# Environment
############################

module load mafft

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

cd "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting MAFFT alignments"
echo "Input directory:    $INPUT_DIR"
echo "Orthogroup list:    $ORTHOGROUP_LIST"
echo "Output directory:   $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo "Parallel jobs:      $NCPU"
echo "Start time:         $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"
echo "MAFFT version:"
mafft --version
echo

############################
# Alignment function
############################

align_one() {

    og="$1"

    # Remove possible Windows carriage returns
    og="${og//$'\r'/}"

    # Skip empty lines
    [[ -z "$og" ]] && return

    infile="${INPUT_DIR}/${og}.fa"
    outfile="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${og}.aln.fa"

    # Check whether the input file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$infile" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Input file not found: $infile" >&2
        return
    fi

    # Skip already completed alignments
    if [[ -s "$outfile" ]]; then
        echo "Skipping existing alignment: $og"
        return
    fi

    echo "Aligning: $og"

    mafft \
        --auto \
        --thread 1 \
        "$infile" \
        > "$outfile"
}

export -f align_one
export INPUT_DIR
export OUTPUT_DIR

############################
# Run selected orthogroups
############################

grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST" |
    xargs -n 1 -P "$NCPU" bash -c 'align_one "$1"' _

############################
# Summary
############################

N_SELECTED=$(grep -cv '^[[:space:]]*$' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST")

N_OUTPUT=$(find "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    -maxdepth 1 \
    -type f \
    -name "*.aln.fa" \
    -size +0c |
    wc -l)

echo
echo "MAFFT alignment finished"
echo "Selected orthogroups: $N_SELECTED"
echo "Completed alignments: $N_OUTPUT"
echo "End time:             $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"

# clean the SCRATCH directory
clean_scratch
```
